title: 第65章 震撼全场！
content_zh:
第65章 震撼全场！-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

今年，《鲁玉有约》搬到了湘省，并在芒果台独家播出。

一个是全国最抓马的访谈节目。

另一个是全国最会搞事情的电视台。

两者强强联合，做大做强，再创辉煌。

别看鲁大头经常被人吐槽不专业，但有些大佬还就喜欢这种风格，经常在她面前表现的特别真实，比如唱一无所有的王首富.....

现阶段，《鲁玉有约》非常火，不少知名演员歌手都上过这档节目。

整个8月，《画皮》剧组就上两个节目，一个是《鲁玉有约》，还有一个是《艺术人生》

为参加这个节目，魏沐找剧组请了三天假。

李导演大手一挥，欣然批准。

如果换做其他人，老李肯定不会答应，魏沐他不一样，人家现在够火，必须优待。

奥运会刚刚结束，整个城市仍然沉浸在一片欢腾的海洋之中。

拉开车门，上了车，摘下口罩，看向坐在副驾驶的助理。

“小刘，节目几点钟录制？”

“沐哥，下午一点开始录制，我们先去吃个饭。”

确实该吃饭，他吃不惯飞机供应的午餐。

也不知道啥时候能买个私人飞机，专门请个厨子给自己做饭，想吃啥吃啥。

这年头，有实力买私人飞机的明星真没几个。

本山大叔绝对算一个，而且他不仅有实力买，还真这样做。

明年，这位东北横趟的大佬就会买下人生中第一架私人飞机。

........

下午，亚洲电视城。

未来几年，《鲁豫有约》都在这个地方录制。

很多人不知道，这档节目其实是国内制播分离的先驱者。

湖南台只作为播出平台，不插手制作，而节目制作则由凤凰卫视内部制作团队负责。

节目后台，魏沐见到了导演以及几位主演。

陈佳上满脸笑容的拉着他介绍：“这位就是魏沐，我们电影主题曲的作者。”

对于魏沐答应邀请，他是感谢的，毕竟对方人气很高，一起录制节目能够增加电影知名度。

有导演介绍，几位主演笑着打招呼。

魏沐和两位男主演握了握手，尤其是叶师傅。

他用粤语说道：“你好啊，子丹老师。”

说起来叶师傅也是惨，《画皮》明明是打着他的名号建组，没想到拍到最后他的戏份还不如两位女主角。

听到亲切的粤语，甄子单用力握了握手。

“你的粤语很不错。”

“沐仔的粤语很好。”

陈佳上跟着夸奖一句。

陈琨和周公子诧异的看了这位年轻人一眼。

他是大陆的吧，粤语这么好？

This year, "A Date with Lu Yu" moved to Hunan Province and was exclusively broadcast on Mango Channel.

One is the most catchy talk show in the country.

The other is the most trouble-making TV station in the country.

The two will join forces to become bigger and stronger and create greater glory.

Even though Lu Datou is often criticized for being unprofessional, some bosses still like this style and often act very real in front of her, such as singing about the richest man with nothing...

At this stage, "A Date with Lu Yu" is very popular, and many well-known actors and singers have appeared on this show.

Throughout August, the crew of "Painted Skin" will present two programs, one is "A Date with Lu Yu" and the other is "Art Life"

In order to participate in this show, Wei Mu asked the crew to take three days off.

Director Li waved his hand and readily approved.

If it were anyone else, Lao Li would definitely not agree. Wei Mu was different. He was so popular now that he had to be given preferential treatment.

The Olympic Games have just ended, and the whole city is still immersed in a sea of ​​joy.

He opened the door, got in the car, took off his mask, and looked at the assistant sitting in the passenger seat.

"Xiao Liu, what time will the show be recorded?"

"Brother Mu, we will start recording at one o'clock in the afternoon. Let's go have a meal first."

It was time to eat, he couldn't get used to the lunch served on the plane.

I don’t know when I can buy a private jet, hire a chef to cook for myself, and eat whatever I want.

These days, there are really not many celebrities who can afford to buy a private jet.

Uncle Benshan is definitely one of them, and he not only has the strength to buy it, he actually does it.

Next year, this Northeastern travel boss will buy his first private jet.

........

Afternoon, Asia Television City.

In the next few years, "Date with Luyu" will be recorded at this place.

Many people don’t know that this program is actually a pioneer in the separation of domestic production and broadcasting.

Hunan TV only serves as a broadcast platform and does not intervene in production, while program production is handled by Phoenix TV's internal production team.

Backstage at the show, Wei Mu met the director and several leading actors.

Chen Jiashang pulled him with a smile on his face and introduced him: "This is Wei Mu, the author of the theme song of our movie."

He was grateful to Wei Mu for agreeing to the invitation. After all, the other party was very popular, and recording a program together would increase the movie's popularity.

The director introduced him, and several leading actors smiled and said hello.

Wei Mu shook hands with the two leading actors, especially Master Ye.

He said in Cantonese: "Hello, Teacher Zidan."

Speaking of Master Ye, it was also miserable. "Painted Skin" was obviously created in his name, but in the end, his role was not as good as the two heroines.

Hearing the kind words in Cantonese, Donnie Yen shook hands vigorously.

"Your Cantonese is very good."

“Mu Zai’s Cantonese is very good.”

Chen Jiashang followed up with a compliment.

Chen Kun and Mr. Zhou looked at the young man in surprise.

He is from mainland China, right? Cantonese is so good?
